stage_verifier_role: Approved immutable SOURCE descriptor; no final runtime bindings or actual final-stage PASS required at initial capture.
initial_census: Every current through282-prefixed I directory except six explicitly deferred roots, plus all prefix files, two mandatory non-prefix whitespace helper sources, supplied --extra-file paths, and exact new B nonlanding paths. Full ordinary internal subtree also named directly.
extra_file_contract: Root must supply every other actual completed non-prefix I helper outside captured roots; code cannot infer unspecified non-prefix sources.
alias_contract: Stable full reads and all symlink components for current descriptors; no directory aliases or broken links in censuses. Old coverage identity and leaf alias are checked twice in initial capture, then composer checks old sources/copies/aliases.
supplement_census: Union of all exact initial deferred roots and all then-current prefix directories except supplement output/current caller; all prefix files, mandatory/extra helpers, source helper itself and new B nonlanding paths.
assembler_retention: Initial rows remain exact prefix; all resolved originals unique; ordinary retained records and copies remain exact; new unaliased clean JSON below 2MB only, else complete original external; all logical alias occurrences remain covered.
assembler_import_boundary: At authorized execution only: exact CLI-pinned reviewed composer bytes are compiled into a named inert module. Its __main__ block does not run. Candidate/evidence imports by this reviewer are zero.
payload_contract: No candidate writes or stages any of the 13 payload files or B/WT path. Existing payload and ordinary evidence gates remain downstream; this review does not rerun or remeasure actual payload files.
later_external_contract: Supplement scope/output/caller and later review/release/assembly/bank/stage/commit outputs are explicitly retained externally after their capture boundary, without recursive self-inclusion.
caller_failure_contract: Actual outer callers preserve stdin, full stdout/stderr, exit, argv/cwd/environment/timing and all failures/partial outputs. No retry into a fixed occupied output.
quiescence_contract: Root establishes that all selected writers finished before capture; repeated reads/censuses detect drift but do not replace quiescence or literal-scope review. Already captured source directories remain immutable afterward.
release_and_acceptance_methods: All four conditional methods retain historical pins/counts/old layouts behind an unconditional exception. They are references only. Current runtime release and acceptance require separately preserved actual-schema adaptations.
